decision.reason: The random-walk model describes bulk log-log increments, near-iid ordinary parity, and (on the longest delay records) pre-peak odd frequency near p*=3/4. It does not give a stable ascent slope a*, the duration-tail rate is about 2.6 I0 on this window, and the exceptional set is the expanding odd prefix already visible in the itinerary. Descriptive, not proof-producing.
